toc: true puts quarto's own contents in the margin of a .html page, which is
where a reader of one looks, so apaquarto does not add a second in the body.
Asking for both used to give two.

A list of figures or of tables is a way of finding a page and .html has no
pages, so it builds neither. Asking for one used to leave an empty div in
the body.
